我单位经常会有来客，有打印座签的需求，一般自己用粉纸打印，省钱！<br>
我们的座签是插纸式的，插纸尺寸如下：8.5*22.5cm&nbsp;&nbsp;类似这种：<br>

代码如下：<br>

<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Python] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: python; gutter: true">#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
座签批量生成工具（左上角对齐版）
- 表格尺寸不变：宽22.54cm，每行高8.43cm
- 表格紧贴A4纸左上角，裁剪只需两刀
- 每个姓名独占一页，无空白页
- 字体：宋体 140pt
"""

import sys
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Cm
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn, nsdecls
from docx.oxml import parse_xml


def create_seat_card(names, output_path="座签.docx"):
    doc = Document()

    # ========== 1. 清除默认内容 ==========
    body = doc.element.body
    for child in list(body):
        tag = child.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in child.tag else child.tag
        if tag != "sectPr":
            body.remove(child)

    # ========== 2. A4横向 + 页边距归零 ==========
    sect_pr = body.find(qn("w:sectPr"))

    pg_sz = sect_pr.find(qn("w:pgSz"))
    if pg_sz is None:
        pg_sz = parse_xml(
            f'&lt;w:pgSz {nsdecls("w")} w:w="16838" w:h="11906" w:orient="landscape"/&gt;'
        )
        sect_pr.insert(0, pg_sz)
    else:
        pg_sz.set(qn("w:w"), "16838")
        pg_sz.set(qn("w:h"), "11906")
        pg_sz.set(qn("w:orient"), "landscape")

    # ★ 页边距全部设为0，让表格贴到纸张左上角 ★
    pg_mar = sect_pr.find(qn("w:pgMar"))
    zero_margins = {
        qn("w:top"): "0", qn("w:right"): "0",
        qn("w:bottom"): "0", qn("w:left"): "0",
        qn("w:header"): "0", qn("w:footer"): "0",
        qn("w:gutter"): "0",
    }
    if pg_mar is None:
        mar_xml = (
            f'&lt;w:pgMar {nsdecls("w")} '
            + " ".join(f'{k}="{v}"' for k, v in zero_margins.items())
            + "/&gt;"
        )
        sect_pr.append(parse_xml(mar_xml))
    else:
        for k, v in zero_margins.items():
            pg_mar.set(k, v)

    # ========== 3. 逐个添加姓名 ==========
    # ★ 表格尺寸保持不变 ★
    table_width_twips = int(Cm(22.54) / 635)   # 22.54cm
    row_height_twips = int(Cm(8.43) / 635)      # 8.43cm

    border_xml = (
        '&lt;w:tcBorders %s&gt;'
        '&lt;w:top w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/&gt;'
        '&lt;w:left w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/&gt;'
        '&lt;w:bottom w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/&gt;'
        '&lt;w:right w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/&gt;'
        "&lt;/w:tcBorders&gt;" % nsdecls("w")
    )

    valid_names = [n.strip() for n in names if n.strip()]

    for idx, name in enumerate(valid_names):
        children_before = len(list(body))

        table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
        # ★ 改为左对齐（原来是CENTER）★
        table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.LEFT

        # 删除 add_table 自动生成的空段落
        for elem in list(body)[children_before:]:
            tag = elem.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in elem.tag else elem.tag
            if tag == "p" and not "".join(elem.itertext()).strip():
                body.remove(elem)

        # --- 表格宽度（保持原尺寸）---
        tbl_pr = table._tbl.tblPr
        tbl_w = tbl_pr.find(qn("w:tblW"))
        if tbl_w is None:
            tbl_w = parse_xml(f'&lt;w:tblW {nsdecls("w")} w:type="dxa" w:w="0"/&gt;')
            tbl_pr.append(tbl_w)
        tbl_w.set(qn("w:type"), "dxa")
        tbl_w.set(qn("w:w"), str(table_width_twips))

        # --- 行高 &amp; 单元格 ---
        for row in table.rows:
            tr = row._tr
            tr_pr = tr.find(qn("w:trPr"))
            if tr_pr is None:
                tr_pr = parse_xml(f'&lt;w:trPr {nsdecls("w")}/&gt;')
                tr.insert(0, tr_pr)
            tr_h = tr_pr.find(qn("w:trHeight"))
            if tr_h is None:
                tr_h = parse_xml(
                    f'&lt;w:trHeight {nsdecls("w")} w:val="0" w:hRule="exact"/&gt;'
                )
                tr_pr.append(tr_h)
            tr_h.set(qn("w:val"), str(row_height_twips))
            tr_h.set(qn("w:hRule"), "exact")

            cell = row.cells[0]
            tc = cell._tc
            tc_pr = tc.find(qn("w:tcPr"))
            if tc_pr is None:
                tc_pr = parse_xml(f'&lt;w:tcPr {nsdecls("w")}/&gt;')
                tc.insert(0, tc_pr)

            old_borders = tc_pr.find(qn("w:tcBorders"))
            if old_borders is not None:
                tc_pr.remove(old_borders)
            tc_pr.append(parse_xml(border_xml))

            v_align = tc_pr.find(qn("w:vAlign"))
            if v_align is None:
                v_align = parse_xml(f'&lt;w:vAlign {nsdecls("w")} w:val="center"/&gt;')
                tc_pr.append(v_align)
            else:
                v_align.set(qn("w:val"), "center")

            tc_mar = tc_pr.find(qn("w:tcMar"))
            if tc_mar is not None:
                tc_pr.remove(tc_mar)
            tc_pr.append(parse_xml(
                f'&lt;w:tcMar {nsdecls("w")}&gt;'
                '&lt;w:top w:w="0" w:type="dxa"/&gt;'
                '&lt;w:left w:w="0" w:type="dxa"/&gt;'
                '&lt;w:bottom w:w="0" w:type="dxa"/&gt;'
                '&lt;w:right w:w="0" w:type="dxa"/&gt;'
                "&lt;/w:tcMar&gt;"
            ))

            para = cell.paragraphs[0]
            para.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            run = para.add_run(name)
            run.font.size = Pt(140)
            run.font.name = "宋体"
            rpr = run._element.get_or_add_rPr()
            rfonts = rpr.find(qn("w:rFonts"))
            if rfonts is None:
                rfonts = parse_xml(f'&lt;w:rFonts {nsdecls("w")}/&gt;')
                rpr.insert(0, rfonts)
            rfonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "宋体")
            rfonts.set(qn("w:ascii"), "宋体")
            rfonts.set(qn("w:hAnsi"), "宋体")

            p_pr = para._p.get_or_add_pPr()
            spacing = p_pr.find(qn("w:spacing"))
            if spacing is None:
                spacing = parse_xml(
                    f'&lt;w:spacing {nsdecls("w")} w:before="0" w:after="0"'
                    ' w:line="240" w:lineRule="auto"/&gt;'
                )
                p_pr.append(spacing)
            else:
                spacing.set(qn("w:before"), "0")
                spacing.set(qn("w:after"), "0")

        if idx &lt; len(valid_names) - 1:
            body.append(parse_xml(
                f'&lt;w:p {nsdecls("w")}&gt;&lt;w:r&gt;&lt;w:br w:type="page"/&gt;&lt;/w:r&gt;&lt;/w:p&gt;'
            ))

    # ========== 4. 清理末尾空段落 ==========
    for child in reversed(list(body)):
        tag = child.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in child.tag else child.tag
        if tag == "sectPr":
            continue
        if tag == "p" and not "".join(child.itertext()).strip():
            body.remove(child)
        else:
            break

    doc.save(output_path)
    print(f"&amp;#9989; 座签已生成：{output_path}（共 {len(valid_names)} 人）")


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) &gt; 1:
        raw = " ".join(sys.argv[1:])
    else:
        raw = input("请输入姓名（多人用逗号分隔）：").strip()

    names = [n.strip() for n in raw.replace("，", ",").split(",") if n.strip()]
    if not names:
        print("&amp;#10060; 未输入有效姓名")
        sys.exit(1)

    create_seat_card(names)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</pre></div><br>
<br>
<br>
大家可以根据实际自行调整尺寸和字体。<br>
<br>
座签批量生成工具（左上角对齐版）<br>
- 表格尺寸不变：宽22.54cm，每行高8.43cm<br>
- 表格紧贴A4纸左上角，裁剪只需两刀<br>
- 每个姓名独占一页，无空白页<br>
- 字体：宋体 140pt<br>
<br>
输入时，姓名用逗号间隔<br>
